title: Whopper®
slide_intent: Treat a signature product name consistently because its visual form helps people distinguish it from other offerings.
strategic_value: A fixed Whopper wordmark can support product recognition across packaging and menus.
demonstration: Two large pale Whopper wordmarks on brown compare the registered version with the restaurant-signage-only version without registration.
practical_value: Use the supplied configuration for product identification, retaining the stated exception for ordinary paragraph copy.
